extracted.intended_audience: readers of historical scholarship and general readers interested in 17th-century British history (Stuart period)
extracted.subtask_description: A German-language excerpt of a political-historical narrative about James II's court, its factions (Rochester, Tyrconnel, Jesuits, foreign ambassadors) and key personalities; suitable for study or citation in works on late-17th-century Britain. Not a guideline or rubric — primary prose narrative from a history book.
